concept.reason: Direct reference imagery and taxon-specific sources sufficient for original silhouette; no extra concept image.

scope: Original Encrinurus egani living stylization based on fossil photographs, not an exact individual replica.

scientific_limits.en: Ventral limbs, antennae, color, posture and body thickness are inferred. The Wisconsin image is an internal mold, not intact external cuticle; the AMNH plate has a displaced head element. Bump and rib counts are simplified, not specimen-exact. Approximate 4 cm length follows the AMNH caption, not measurement of the Wisconsin mold.
scientific_limits.zh: 腹面肢、触角、颜色、姿态及体厚为推断。威斯康星图像为内模，并非完整外骨骼；AMNH图版有移位的头部结构。瘤点及肋条数量经过简化，不是精确标本计数。约4厘米长度依据AMNH图注，不是威斯康星内模的实测值。

taxon_scope: Encrinurus egani; do not substitute historical E.variolaris now treated as Balizoma

dimensions_estimate_m.basis: Length approximately follows AMNH caption; breadth and height artistic.

shape_requirements: Original pimpled vaulted head versus densely ribbed triangular tailshield contrast remains clear.
Head has rounded low tubercles and paired elevated eyes, not smooth spherical Deiphon glabella.
Distinct articulated thorax separates head from a tapering triangular fused pygidium with dense ribs and central axis.
Tailshield is a ribbed plate, not a fan of separate insect legs or a long forked tail.
construction_notes: Merge tubercles and rib geometry into few meshes to stay within budget; no exact count claim.
Do not copy the AMNH displaced head element as a second tail structure.
Ventral appendages small and subordinate; warm gray-brown color artistic rather than fossil pigment.

shape_gate.en: Its distinguishing construction is pimpled vaulted head contrasts with a densely ribbed triangular tailshield; retain this geometry rather than treating it as a recolor, scale or pose variant.
shape_gate.zh: 以乳突拱头与密肋三角尾甲形成对照为独立造型依据；须保留这些结构差异，不能仅靠换色、缩放或姿势区别。

modeling_brief.en: Original low-poly direction: establish pimpled vaulted head contrasts with a densely ribbed triangular tailshield in the blockout, then preserve the largest silhouette breaks and openings. Simplify fine ornament and repeated elements without copying reference meshes; palette and presentation are artistic choices, not fossil evidence.
modeling_brief.zh: 原创低多边形方向：先以乳突拱头与密肋三角尾甲形成对照搭建体块，再保留主要外轮廓转折与孔隙。细纹及重复结构可简化，不复制参考网格；配色与展示方式属于美术选择，并非化石证据。

material_profile: palette-only static original geometry; restrained natural palette; no reference images embedded
gray_model_gate: Three low-cost front/side/oblique checks before detailing; original inventory shape combination must read. No extra views except a specific unresolved problem.
final_evidence: Four exact-export front/side/top/perspective views; perspective may equal preview. Existing technical/export/viewer gates, two isolated rebuilds and fresh independent QA remain required.
